title: A kpọrọ gị na Vaultara
intro: Vaultara na-eleba anya n'akwụkwọ gị ma gwa gị tupu ha agwụ.
nocode: Njikọ a enweghị koodu ya. Rịọ enyi gị ka o zighachi ya.
note: Wụnye ngwa ahụ wee mepụta akaụntụ gị. Mgbe ahụ mepee Profaịlụ, pịa Kpọọ ndị enyi wee tinye koodu ahụ n'ime ụbọchị 14. Unu abụọ na-enweta otu ọnwa n'efu nke Premium ozugbo e kwenyesịrị email gị ma ị tinye ndekọ mbụ gị.
